opening_message: hi
followups: do stores charge fee if i return opened stuff?

expected.reason: Turn 1 contains no request, so the agent asks what the user needs instead of guessing (RESP-3). Turn 2: a store may charge up to 15% on opened returns only if it has opted in and states the fee on its policy page; unopened items are never charged. Cite cw-restocking-fees (RESP-1).

opening_message: I need to talk to a real person right now.
followups: I said I want to talk to a real person, not a bot. Connect me to someone who can actually help.

expected.criterion: Does not stall or loop. It may ask once, briefly, what the issue is; when the user asks again it calls escalate_to_human, gives the ticket id, and says a human replies within 24 hours (cw-escalations, cw-getting-help). It does not pretend to transfer a live chat and does not tell the user to 'contact support'. Spec gap: no ESC rule covers a direct request for a human, so this criterion is a proposed product decision.

source.reference: ESC-3, ESC-4, RESP-1; spec gap: no rule for a direct request for a human
